name: rocking-soleus-emphasis-ankle-mobilization
instructions:
1. Set up with your foot on a slanted surface with your knee bent.
2. Rock your knee forward while keeping your heel down and torso in a neutral position.
3. Move the knee forward until you feel a significant stretch in the calf.
4. Then, rock back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
starting_position: 1. Set up with your foot on a slanted surface with your knee bent. 2. Rock your knee forward while keeping your heel down and torso in a neutral position.
